laws.description: Every stolen calorie brings the bunker closer to the brink. Offenders are bled of their own rations to repay the debt, learning the true cost of hunger.
Petty violence is a luxury we cannot afford. Aggressors are confined to the unheated sub-levels in complete darkness until their blood cools.

laws.display_name: Exile Decree: Sabotage of Shelter Infrastructure
laws.description: To damage the life-support systems is to murder us all. Saboteurs are stripped of their gear and cast into the howling, irradiated storms of the surface.
The ultimate betrayal demands the ultimate price. A single bullet is an expensive waste, but a necessary sacrifice to excise the rot from our fragile society.
